name: QRdx Self-Hosted
free_limit: Free self-hosted AGPL-3.0 web application for static and dynamic QR codes, hosted pages, scan analytics, and API; no software usage quota stated. Docker Compose deployment includes PostgreSQL; infrastructure and optional third-party services are user-provided.
watch_out: Open-core: workspace SSO, audit log, client portal/reports, white-label pages/custom CSS, and conversion tracking in ee/ require a paid commercial agreement for production. AGPL source-sharing obligations apply to modified network deployments; QRdx trademarks are excluded. Docker setup is new; production hardening and infrastructure costs are the operator's responsibility.
